conviction_note: H1 was pre-released to the 100m yen on 2026-10-19 (sales 370, OP 115, ordinary 250, NI 180 億円) with the full-year plan explicitly held, the 2026-10-20 pop has fully round-tripped on a sector-wide game selloff, there is no interim dividend and no buyback habit, so the print adds little beyond the FY decision; last year's identical sequence (pre-revision 2025-10-23, print 2025-10-27 holding FY) traded -1.84% next day, which gives a slight negative lean that I hold near 50 because the street (EPS 110 vs plan ~95) already looks through the conservative plan and the company's wording this year leaves the FY raise open.
bar: The company's own revised H1 forecast of 2026-10-19 (ordinary profit 25,000m yen, OP 11,500m, NI 18,000m), https://www.release.tdnet.info/inbs/140120261019552780.pdf. FY bar: company plan OP 32,000m / NI 31,000m (EPS ~95) against Yahoo/Refinitiv consensus FY EPS 110.0 from 9 analysts (quoteSummary earningsTrend, read 2026-10-26). Last year the revised H1 ordinary of 175 landed at 177, hence +1%.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-10-23 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, via baseline). 信用倍率 24.86x on kabutan 2026-10-26 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3635): margin long crowded. No options, no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.71, almost all margin overhang. No squeeze setup.

findings.finding: The H1 was pre-released on 2026-10-19 16:00 via 業績予想の修正 (sales 34,000->37,000m, OP 7,000->11,500m, ordinary 12,000->25,000m, NI 9,000->18,000m yen), so the reported half and Q2 (Jul-Sep) are known to the 100m yen before the 決算短信.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-23 pre-revision of H1 ordinary 80->175: stock +3.07% next day (2054->2117), then the 2025-10-27 print with H1 at 177 traded -1.84% (2094->2055.5). This year the 10-19 revision bought +3.75% on 10-20 (1678.5->1741.5) and was fully given back by 10-23 (1658).
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: it was released a week ago and traded. Filed so the pre-release is on record and nothing is sized on the quarter itself.
findings.independence: Same fact reported by kabutan https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3635&b=k202610190013 (one document, counted once).

findings.finding: The full-year plan (OP 32,000m, ordinary 42,000m, NI 31,000m) was held at the 10-19 revision with H1 ordinary already 59.5% of the FY figure and implied H2 ordinary of 17,000m against 39,300m last H2; the company's pattern is to hold the FY at Q2 (held 2025-10-27 too) and raise it in a pre-revision before the full-year print (2026-04-20), so the likely outcome is a held plan the street (FY EPS 110 vs plan ~95) already looks through, with a minority chance of a raise because this year's wording ('現時点で修正はございませんが...引き続き検討') is softer than last year's justified no-change.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY held at the Q2 print on 2025-10-27: -1.84% next session. FY raised by pre-revision on 2026-04-20 (FY26 ordinary to 570): the April print day then fell -3.7% (baseline estimated cadence) on a FY27 guide of -26%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the hold was announced in the same document and the 10-20 rally retraced; what is not priced is only the small probability that the print itself raises the FY. If the market expected a raise tomorrow the stock would not have given back the whole revision pop into the print.
findings.independence: Last year's analog: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3635&b=k202510230031 and https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=3635&b=k202510270032 (FY 370 held at both). Consensus FY EPS 110 from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v10/finance/quoteSummary/3635.T?modules=earningsTrend

findings.finding: Margin longs are crowded at 信用倍率 24.86x with no disclosed short, into a print whose good news was pre-released and whose post-revision gain has already been given back, which leaves sell-the-news supply and no squeeze fuel.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Not measurable from the baseline; last year's equivalent print (FY held after a pre-revision) fell 1.84%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is the margin_overhang component (-0.70) of the baseline lean. Kept small because it agrees with the positioning rather than beating it.

outside_window.finding: Full-year upward revision looks likely eventually (H1 ordinary 250 of 420 FY; H2 titles 進撃の巨人3 reportedly 2026-12-10 and Wo Long 2 early 2027), but the company's habit is a pre-revision ahead of the full-year print in April.

baseline_tension: Agrees with the mildly negative lean (margin overhang) and cuts against nothing in the flat run-up; the strongest positive the release could carry is a FY raise or new title dates, which I looked for, and the company's softer 'still considering' wording is the reason p_up stays near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (negative resting on what the market already has): the positioning finding is the baseline's own margin-overhang component, so it was cut from -0.3 to -0.2 and p_up moved 45 -> 47.
Rule 2 (negative tilt): wrote the strongest positive (FY raise, title news) into baseline_tension; I had already looked, so no further p_up change.
Open question 3 (prior 業績予想の修正 kills the event): consistent with the 0.0 already on the pre-released quarter and with abs_move held below the 3.47 proxy; left standing.
